title: Wall Mount Paper Towel Holder 15.5-Inch Iron Pipeline Collection | Pink | Allied Brass
description:
Keep paper towels within easy reach and free up counter space with this wall mount paper towel holder for the kitchen in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to kitchens design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality. From the Pipeline collection, it delivers an industrial, pipe-fitting inspired design that works well with transitional bathroom hardware styling adapted for versatile kitchen and home decor.

Highlights:
- Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 19 designer finishes to match the rest of your kitchen
- Industrial style that blends with modern and traditional decor
- Color coordinated mounting hardware included
- Limited lifetime warranty

Specs:
- Mounting type: Wall mount
- Material: Iron
- Dimensions: 15.5 in L x 4 in W x 3 in H; projection 4 in
- Product weight: 1.3 lb
- Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 in
- Included items: paper towel holder and all installation hardware
- Assembly required: No
- Finish variety: multiple designer finish options available
